title: Ligatures & Swashes
slide_intent: Make expressive type features reproducible because their intended appearance depends on both font choice and software settings.
strategic_value: A visible feature inventory and activation instructions can reduce inconsistent Flame rendering across Burger King production teams.
demonstration: Two ligature grids compare Bold and Regular, a swash grid appears at upper right, and two software-panel screenshots accompany activation instructions.
practical_value: Enable ligatures in the typesetting application and confirm the chosen glyph feature exists in the selected style.

content_islands.name: Feature and software instructions
content_islands.spec: Place usage text and InDesign/Illustrator panel examples in the left column.

content_islands.name: Ligature specimens
content_islands.spec: Stack Bold and Regular glyph grids in the center.

content_islands.name: Swash specimens
content_islands.spec: Place the Bold-only alternate letters at upper right.

ingredient.name: Flame OpenType features
ingredient.role: Produce the intended joined forms consistently.
ingredient.application: Enable ligatures for Flame Bold in the character-style or OpenType controls; use swashes sparingly and avoid them in longer lines.
ingredient.scope: Historical 2020 partner guidelines, PDF produced January 2021. Printed examples require BK legal trademark clearance and local legal review before use.

reference_purposes.Expression: The specimen grids display the actual joined letters and swash forms.
reference_purposes.Application: The page shows where to enable ligatures in InDesign and Illustrator.
reference_purposes.Constraint: It says ligatures must be on whenever Flame Bold is used and repeats the limit on swashes in longer copy.
